fact: Telecom Review Africa reports that the Rwandan government updated its National Broadband Policy and Strategy in 2022, introducing technology neutrality and spectrum refarming; it gives no period for the plan and names no successor (document published 2025-10-22).

The Ministry of Youth and ICT's National Broadband Policy for Rwanda (Kigali, October 2013) sets a vision of universal broadband access by 2020 and a proposed action plan with targets and costs to start upon approval of the policy; the document does not state that it was approved.
